title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A laundromat owner is pulled into a multiverse crisis and must reconnect with the people closest to her. It is a fast, imaginative science-fiction story with family drama at its centre.

title: The Holdovers
description: Over a winter break, a strict teacher, a grieving cook and a stranded student form an unexpected connection. It is a character-led comedy-drama with a warm, reflective tone.

title: The Banshees of Inisherin
description: A sudden end to a lifelong friendship unsettles two men on a small island. The film turns a simple break-up of companionship into a darkly comic and increasingly painful drama.

title: RRR
description: Two men with opposing public roles forge a powerful friendship during colonial rule in India. It is a large-scale action drama built around spectacle, music and emotional stakes.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three engineering students challenge the pressure and expectations around academic success. The story balances campus comedy with questions about curiosity, ambition and friendship.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to compete in a sport rarely open to them in their community. It is a family and sports drama about discipline, opportunity and determination.

title: The Lunchbox
description: A mistaken lunch delivery begins a private exchange between two strangers in Mumbai. The film is a quiet drama about routine, loneliness and the possibility of connection.

title: Kantara
description: A village conflict over land and tradition grows into a larger story shaped by local ritual and belief. It combines action, mystery and folklore in a rural setting.

title: Jallikattu
description: When a buffalo escapes into a village, an attempt to capture it exposes fear, rivalry and crowd instinct. This tense thriller turns a local emergency into social chaos.

title: The Wedding Party
description: A high-profile Lagos wedding brings families, friends and competing expectations into the same celebration. It is a social comedy built around romance, ceremony and family pressure.

title: Lionheart
description: A determined woman steps into her father’s transport business and faces resistance from those who doubt her. It is a family drama about leadership, responsibility and resilience.

title: King of Boys
description: A powerful businesswoman enters a dangerous political struggle while trying to hold on to influence and loyalty. It is a crime drama about power, ambition and consequence.

title: The Black Book
description: A grieving father searches for the truth after his son is accused of a crime. The thriller follows his path through corruption, loss and a dangerous demand for justice.

title: Eyimofe
description: Two Lagos residents prepare for a hoped-for future abroad while ordinary setbacks reshape their plans. It is a patient drama about work, migration, family and possibility.

title: Citation
description: A postgraduate student challenges the behaviour of a powerful lecturer at her university. The drama examines authority, evidence and the personal cost of speaking up.

title: Aníkúlápó
description: A traveller’s search for a new life takes an unexpected turn after he encounters a power tied to death and rebirth. It is a Yoruba-language fantasy drama rooted in moral choices.

title: Decision to Leave
description: A detective becomes drawn to a woman connected to a death he is investigating. The romantic mystery follows obsession, distance and the uncertainty of what can be known.

title: The Wailing
description: A rural police officer investigates a violent illness spreading through his village. The mystery moves between fear, faith and uncertainty as the threat grows closer to home.

title: Shoplifters
description: A family living at the edges of Tokyo takes in a young girl and confronts what family means beyond blood. It is an intimate drama about care, survival and belonging.

title: Drive My Car
description: A theatre director forms a quiet bond with the driver assigned to him while preparing a multilingual production. The drama explores grief, performance and difficult conversations.

title: The Social Network
description: A college student’s social-network project grows into a company while friendships and ownership fracture around it. It is a fast, dialogue-driven drama about ambition, invention and betrayal.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young drummer enters the demanding world of an elite music conservatory. The intense drama asks what a person may sacrifice in pursuit of greatness.

title: The Nice Guys
description: A mismatched private investigator and enforcer investigate a missing person case in 1970s Los Angeles. The film blends mystery, action and deadpan comedy.

title: The Farewell
description: A writer returns to China when her family gathers around her ill grandmother while keeping difficult news from her. It is a gentle family story about love, culture and grief.

title: Past Lives
description: Two childhood friends reconnect years after one emigrates from South Korea. The quiet drama considers memory, identity and the lives shaped by choices.

title: Lagaan
description: Villagers facing a crushing colonial tax challenge their rulers to a cricket match despite having little experience of the game. It is a sports drama about solidarity and resistance.

title: Gully Boy
description: A young man from Mumbai finds a voice through rap while navigating family pressure and social expectations. The film follows creativity, friendship and the drive to be heard.

title: Tumbbad
description: A man’s search for a hidden fortune leads him deeper into a dangerous family legend. This period horror tale connects greed with a haunting folklore-inspired world.

title: Super Deluxe
description: Several lives intersect across one extraordinary day as families confront secrets, judgement and chance. The film moves between dark humour, drama and moral uncertainty.

title: Kumbalangi Nights
description: Four brothers living in a coastal village must confront their strained relationships when new people enter their lives. It is a warm but clear-eyed family drama.

title: October 1
description: A police officer investigates a murder in a newly independent Nigerian town. The period mystery uses one case to explore fear, power and social tension.

title: The Figurine
description: Friends find an ancient object said to bring good fortune before turning against them. The supernatural mystery explores belief, friendship and consequence.

title: 93 Days
description: Health workers and officials respond to an Ebola case in Lagos. The drama focuses on coordination, courage and the human stakes of a public-health emergency.

title: Merry Men
description: A group of wealthy friends in Abuja use charm and confidence to navigate romance and trouble. It is a glossy social comedy about friendship and consequences.

title: Brotherhood
description: Two brothers are separated by the choices they make around crime and survival. The crime drama follows loyalty, pressure and the cost of violence.

title: Memories of Murder
description: Detectives investigate a series of murders in a rural town while evidence and methods repeatedly fail them. The crime drama balances procedural tension with frustration and uncertainty.

title: A Taxi Driver
description: A Seoul taxi driver agrees to take a foreign journalist on a journey that changes his understanding of events in Gwangju. It is a historical drama about witness and responsibility.

title: The Handmaiden
description: A young woman joins an heiress’s household as part of a con, but shifting loyalties transform the plan. The period thriller is built on deception, desire and reversals.

title: Tokyo Story
description: An elderly couple visits their adult children in Tokyo and discovers how time and responsibility have changed family life. It is a restrained drama about generations and distance.

title: Perfect Blue
description: A pop idol leaves music for acting and begins to question what is real as pressure and obsession close in. This psychological animated thriller examines identity and image.

title: Casablanca
description: A romantic wartime drama set in Casablanca, where an expatriate club owner faces an old love and a difficult moral choice.

title: Singin’ in the Rain
description: A musical comedy about Hollywood’s transition from silent films to sound, told through romance, performance and studio chaos.

title: The Godfather
description: A crime drama about a powerful family and the son drawn into its world of loyalty, violence and succession.

title: Jaws
description: A coastal community confronts a deadly threat in the water while local leaders struggle over how to respond.

title: Alien
description: A crew aboard a commercial spacecraft encounters a lethal unknown organism. The film combines science fiction, suspense and survival horror.

title: Do the Right Thing
description: On the hottest day of the summer, tensions between neighbours rise on one Brooklyn block. It is a drama about community, identity and conflict.

title: The Truman Show
description: A man begins to suspect that the life he knows has been constructed for an audience. It is a satirical drama about privacy and control.

title: The Iron Giant
description: A young boy befriends a giant robot that has fallen from space. The animated story explores friendship, fear and choice.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A hotel concierge and his young lobby boy become caught up in an inheritance dispute and a series of unlikely adventures.

title: Moonlight
description: A coming-of-age drama following one man through childhood, adolescence and adulthood as he searches for connection and self-understanding.

title: Lady Bird
description: A high-school senior navigates friendship, family conflict and her wish to leave Sacramento for a different future.

title: The Florida Project
description: A child spends a vivid summer near the theme parks of central Florida while her young mother struggles to stay afloat.

title: The Lighthouse
description: Two lighthouse keepers on an isolated island descend into rivalry and uncertainty. It is a claustrophobic psychological horror story.

title: The Green Knight
description: A young knight accepts a dangerous challenge that tests his courage, honour and understanding of legend.

title: Minari
description: A Korean American family moves to rural Arkansas to begin a new life and build a farm. The drama follows work, family and belonging.

title: Aftersun
description: A grown woman remembers a childhood holiday with her father and begins to see moments from that trip differently.

title: The Zone of Interest
description: A family’s domestic life unfolds beside a Nazi concentration camp. The historical drama examines ordinary routine alongside atrocity.

title: All Quiet on the Western Front
description: A young German soldier confronts the physical and emotional reality of the First World War. It is an anti-war drama about survival and disillusionment.

title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
description: A young man tries to reclaim a family home in a changing city. The drama explores memory, friendship and belonging.

title: Sound of Metal
description: A drummer experiences sudden hearing loss and must reconsider his identity, relationships and future.

title: Sholay
description: Two small-time criminals are hired to protect a village from a ruthless bandit. It is a large-scale action drama with comedy and friendship at its core.

title: Pather Panchali
description: A family in rural Bengal faces hardship while two children discover the world around them. It is an intimate coming-of-age drama.

title: Queen
description: After her wedding is called off, a young woman takes the planned honeymoon alone and discovers new confidence through travel.

title: Andhadhun
description: A pianist becomes entangled in a murder case after witnessing something he was never meant to see. The thriller plays with perception and deception.

title: Drishyam
description: A family man constructs an elaborate alibi to protect his family after a tragic incident. The thriller centres on memory, pressure and consequence.

title: Sairat
description: Two young people from different social backgrounds fall in love and try to build a life away from the expectations around them.

title: Masaan
description: Two stories unfold in Varanasi as young people confront grief, judgement and the possibility of a new beginning.

title: The Great Indian Kitchen
description: A newly married woman confronts the repetitive labour and unequal expectations built into her household life.

title: Court
description: A folk singer faces prosecution after his work is linked to a worker’s death. The courtroom drama observes institutions and everyday injustice.

title: Udaan
description: A teenager is forced to return home and live under his strict father’s control while trying to pursue his own ambitions.

title: Haider
description: A young man returns to Kashmir to search for his missing father and becomes caught between grief, politics and revenge.

title: Article 15
description: A police officer investigates the disappearance of young women in a village and confronts entrenched caste discrimination.

title: Kaaka Muttai
description: Two brothers from a Chennai neighbourhood become determined to taste pizza after a new restaurant opens nearby.

title: Vikram Vedha
description: A police officer hunting a gangster is drawn into stories that challenge his simple idea of right and wrong.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
description: A young man discovers a kingdom’s history and his connection to a struggle for power. The fantasy adventure is built around mythic scale.

title: The Milkmaid
description: Two sisters are separated by violence in northern Nigeria and struggle to find one another again. It is a drama about survival and family.

title: Òlòtūré
description: An undercover journalist enters a dangerous trafficking network while investigating the exploitation of women.

title: Ije: The Journey
description: A woman travels from Nigeria to the United States to help her sister after a serious accusation. The drama explores family and justice.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
description: Two sisters and the people around them experience love, politics and upheaval during the Nigerian civil war.

title: Phone Swap
description: Two strangers accidentally exchange phones and are pulled into each other’s very different lives. It is a social comedy about connection and chance.

title: Living in Bondage: Breaking Free

title: Gangs of Lagos
description: Friends from a Lagos neighbourhood become involved in political and criminal power struggles as adulthood changes their loyalties.

title: Mami Wata
description: A village faces conflict around faith, leadership and tradition when a challenge emerges to its established spiritual order.

title: The Trade
description: A group of professionals plan a major kidnapping operation, but the scheme tests the limits of trust and control.

title: Breaded Life
description: A privileged young man suddenly finds himself living an ordinary life and must learn to adapt without the advantages he once assumed.

title: Oldboy
description: A man is released after years of unexplained imprisonment and begins a desperate search for the reason he was taken.

title: The Host
description: A family tries to rescue a young girl after a creature emerges from the Han River. The film mixes monster horror with family drama.

title: The Chaser
description: A former detective searches for a missing woman after noticing a pattern among the people connected to his work.

title: I Saw the Devil
description: A secret agent pursues the man responsible for a personal loss, turning the search for justice into a dangerous cycle of revenge.

title: Poetry
description: An older woman begins a poetry class while confronting a painful truth in her family. The film is a quiet drama about attention and responsibility.

title: The Man from Nowhere

title: A Bittersweet Life
description: A loyal enforcer disobeys a powerful boss and finds himself pursued by the organisation he once served.

title: The Housemaid
description: A domestic worker enters a wealthy household where desire, class and power create a dangerous imbalance.

title: Extreme Job
description: A struggling narcotics team opens a fried-chicken restaurant as cover for surveillance and unexpectedly finds success.

title: Burning
description: A young man becomes unsettled by a wealthy acquaintance and a woman he cares about. The mystery unfolds through suspicion and ambiguity.

title: Seven Samurai
description: Farmers hire masterless samurai to defend their village from bandits. The epic action drama examines duty, class and collective survival.

title: Rashomon
description: Several witnesses describe the same violent event in conflicting ways. The film is a classic study of memory, perspective and truth.

title: Akira
description: In a future Tokyo, a teenager gains destructive power while his friend tries to stop the consequences. It is a landmark animated science-fiction story.

title: Battle Royale
description: A class of students is forced into a deadly state-sanctioned contest on a remote island. The thriller examines authority, fear and survival.

title: Departures
